plan.title: Cancel Edit Evaluation Time on Live RFQ

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ directly on its Responses tab as required for prepared-state cases.
Verify the RFQ is still live before opening the dialog.
Verify the precondition that no vendor bids are present.
Open the RFQ Settings menu and choose Edit Evaluation Time, leaving its dialog open.
Confirm the Edit Evaluation Time window opened.
Cancel the evaluation-time edit without saving changes.
Assert that cancelling closes the Edit Evaluation Time window.
Verify the event remains live after cancellation.
Verify that no bids were introduced or changed by cancelling.
